name: sproutforms-frontend
description: The npm workspace of SproutForms' front-end packages: the engine (@sproutforms/client) and the renderers built on it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sproutforms/client && npm run build -w @sproutforms/vue && npm run build -w @sproutforms/nuxt
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sproutforms/client && npm run typecheck -w @sproutforms/vue && npm run typecheck -w @sproutforms/nuxt
